reason: The remediation only edits a single line in /etc/login.defs to set PASS_MIN_DAYS. This is a standard password policy change that does not affect system boot, networking, or critical services, and is unlikely to cause lockout if the value is reasonable (e.g., 1 day).
estimated_impact: authentication/authorization affected; Improper value could prevent immediate password changes; Potential user confusion if minimum age is set too high
